crossRefs.note: The men of Ephraim were gathered together, and passed northward; and they said to Jephthah, “Why did you pass over to…
Behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, “Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen…
For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after…
Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

translations.web: The men of Ephraim said to him, “Why have you treated us this way, that you didn’t call us when you went to fight with Midian?” They rebuked him sharply.
translations.bsb: Then the men of Ephraim said to Gideon, “Why have you done this to us? Why did you fail to call us when you went to fight against Midian?” And they contended with him violently.
translations.kjv: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.
translations.asv: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with Midian? And they did chide with him sharply.
